neighbours.label: The participle ' reported' in a passive 'was/were reported + state' clause in incident reports (were reported stolen, was reported missing), not active 'reported' or the noun 'report'.
fire: Two laptops and a camera were reported stolen from the office on Friday.
A hiker was reported missing near the summit late on Sunday.
Three passengers were reported injured after the bus left the road.
The cargo was reported lost at sea during the storm.
Several cars were reported damaged after the hailstorm on Tuesday night.
The vessel was reported overdue when it failed to reach port.
Four cattle were reported missing from the farm after the gate was left open.
Garden tools and a ladder were reported taken from the shed overnight.
quiet: The office manager reported the theft of two laptops on Friday.
Rangers reported that a hiker had not returned from the summit.
The driver's report said three passengers had minor injuries.
Newspapers reported heavy losses at sea during the storm.
Insurance reporters toured the streets after the hailstorm.
The harbour master reported the vessel's position to the coastguard.
The farmer reported four cattle missing after the gate was left open.
A neighbour noticed the shed door open and called the police.
